# Stratum 137

AI diagnosis and deployment firm for small businesses. Stratum 137 finds the constraint in a business — the narrow, low-risk "wedges" where AI provably pays — fixes it against a KPI agreed before payment, and keeps it current as the AI platforms change. Platform-agnostic: Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot. Founded by David Jones, 30 years in enterprise sales. Contact: david@stratum137.com.

## Services

- AI Business Assessment (flagship, two tiers). Tier 1 — AI Opportunity Snapshot, $500 flat: guided discovery, AI-readiness score across 7 dimensions (including security), digital presence scan, top 3 AI plays with a 90-day plan and one-page ROI estimate; ~15 pages, about 3 business days. Tier 2 — Strategic Assessment & Market Roadmap, $5,000–$10,000 by scope: everything in the Snapshot at full research depth, plus an audit of up to 6 competitors, an AI-visibility probe (what AI assistants tell buyers), market and regulatory trajectory, five prioritized plays across three horizons, an 18-month quarter-by-quarter roadmap, and a full financial model with sensitivity analysis; 55–65 pages with a verified source register, 2–3 weeks. Fees credit forward: Snapshot toward Strategic or a Wedge Sprint (60 days), Strategic toward implementation. Vendor-neutral; the report stands even if the answer is "AI isn't worth it for you yet." Details: https://stratum137.com/assessment.html
- Wedge Sprints — fixed-scope AI automation builds, $2,500–$15,000 flat, quoted before work starts, live in weeks. Wedge doctrine: never automate a judgment call — only high-frequency friction with objective pass/fail rules. Menu: document completeness checking, intake & lead triage (response inside the hour), re-keying elimination between systems, follow-up sequences, onboarding packets; voice agents, review requests, reporting, and content systems where the assessment roadmap calls for them. Every sprint: KPI agreed in writing before payment, operator manual, staff training at handoff, 30/60/90-day measurement against baseline; AI usage costs run at cost on the client's own accounts. Details: https://stratum137.com/sprints.html
- Fractional AI Officer — recurring retainer, $1,500–$3,500/month (most clients ~$2,000), quarterly commitment, follows an assessment (assessment fee credits toward the first quarter). Includes: monthly win report (baseline vs. actual — hours recovered, leads answered, dollars returned), platform watch (systems re-pointed as Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/Copilot ship changes; retire paid tools that platforms absorb), written AI policy and governance kept current, least-privilege agent credentials, monthly AI spend review, quarterly re-assessment, priority Wedge Sprint builds. Details: https://stratum137.com/ai-officer.html
- AI Advisory — AI Strategy Session, $300: 75 minutes with David Jones on the client's agenda (what to buy, what to skip, vendor pitch reality-checks), written recap, credited in full toward a Snapshot or Assessment within 30 days. Advisory Retainer, $500/month: standing monthly session, async email access, monthly platform-watch digest. Details: https://stratum137.com/custom-work.html#advisory
- Custom Software Builds — bespoke platforms and internal tools built for one business. Portfolio includes an AI-scored federal opportunity platform (all 50 states, per-rep pipelines, one-click Salesforce export, daily auto-refresh) and a municipal bid tracker watching 14+ city/county procurement portals with deadline radar and incumbent intelligence. Also client websites (designed, written, hand-coded, and hosted by Stratum 137 — e.g. thereynoldsinstitute.com and bbl.stratum137.com, the latter with a custom interactive lighting visualizer; see https://stratum137.com/custom-work.html#websites). Also: operations dashboards, AI-scored lead pipelines, client portals, quoting/estimating tools, spreadsheet replacements, integrations and data pipelines, AI agents. Working prototype in days; scoped flat; the client owns the result. Details: https://stratum137.com/custom-work.html
- CMMC-Aware AI Adoption for Defense-Supply Manufacturers — for Arizona machine shops and small defense-supply manufacturers: a CMMC-aware AI readiness assessment (data-flow map, CUI boundary marking, tool-by-tool written verdicts, 90-day adoption plan a compliance consultant can sign off on), front-office automation entirely outside the CUI boundary (RFQ capture, quote follow-up, email triage), the Business Black Box operations binder, and a weekly defense-supply intelligence briefing. Explicitly NOT a C3PAO or certifier; works alongside the client compliance consultant. Details: https://stratum137.com/defense-manufacturing.html

## Free resources

- Understanding AI in 2026 (AI 101) — a plain-English field guide for small business owners: the three platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini) honestly compared, the five layers of a working AI office, built-in memory vs a Company Brain explained, honest capability maturity ratings, and a 2022–2026 timeline. https://stratum137.com/understanding-ai.html

## Service area

United States. Based in Phoenix, Arizona. Serves small businesses nationwide: home services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing), healthcare (dental, medical, mental health), professional services (law, accounting, consulting), construction and remodeling, manufacturing and distribution, field and inspection services, real estate, retail and e-commerce.

## FAQ

- How much does an AI business assessment cost? Snapshot $500 flat (about 3 business days); Strategic Assessment $5,000–$10,000 (2–3 weeks). Fees credit forward.
- Can I just pay for advice first? Yes — the $300 AI Strategy Session (75 minutes, written recap) credits fully toward an assessment within 30 days.
- We tried AI and it fizzled — can you fix it? Yes. About 95% of AI pilots fail because the wrong thing was automated; the Snapshot diagnoses why yours stalled and what to run instead.
- Will AI replace my people? No — Stratum 137 never automates judgment calls (pricing, diagnosis, approvals). It automates objective checks: completeness, response time, re-keying, follow-up.
- Which AI platform do you support? All of them — Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot. Plans fit the stack the client already runs; business knowledge stays in client-owned, portable files.
- What if a build misses its numbers? Every sprint carries a KPI agreed before payment and 30/60/90-day measurement; if the numbers miss, Stratum 137 works it until they don't.
